scope: Verification-only composition of A1 identity, A2 authority manifest, optional A3a attenuation proof, A4a signed handoff, A5a portable Grid-terminal receipt, and A6a retained currentness evidence. No effect-specific A5b proof, global currentness, delegation authority or detached-report authentication is created.
core_invariant: Live reverification of supplied artifacts is stronger than checking a detached local report. A Grid intent-start currentness check is not proof of currentness at the first consequential effect, and a terminal Grid lifecycle receipt is not proof of a concrete effect or task success.

controls: executor credential must equal A4 intended-executor identity digest
A6a effect-currentness helper requires expected latest head
sender and executor checkpoint digests are live reverified

risks: treat Grid intent start as first effect boundary
treat completed lifecycle as concrete effect proof
treat process completion as task success
infer ancestor relation from sender/executor checks
controls: A4a delegation head must remain null

risks: fabricate local report and recompute digest
controls: live reverification facts exist only in the direct verifier return object
verifier imports only canonicalization and existing verify/evaluate primitives

risks: claim #1137 effect evidence without importing its strict verifier

known_nonclaims: A10b is not a separately implemented third-party verifier.
A10b does not authenticate its detached verification report.
A10b does not prove global currentness.
A10b does not prove currentness at the first consequential effect boundary.
A10b does not verify a concrete effect-specific A5b receipt.
A10b does not verify A7 memory provenance because A7 remains on a separate laboratory stack.
A10b does not prove delegation ancestry or authority-bearing A3b semantics.
A10b grants no authority and performs no effect.
next_gates: compose #1137 effect-specific verifier without duplicating its security-critical implementation
bind actual late currentness evidence consulted immediately before consume-before-effect
add A3b ancestor relationship when an authority-bearing delegation contract exists
build an independently implemented second verifier/conformance harness
